name: chatgpt-web-bridge
description: A protocol-driven MCP bridge for visible ChatGPT Web planning, Codex App Server execution, and future brain/executor adapters.

interface.shortDescription: Let ChatGPT Web plan while Luna executes.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Web Bridge launches or connects to a dedicated browser session, lets the user sign in manually, relays visible prompts and replies, supports brain-hand planning and evidence-first review, and can bind Codex App Server worker threads to Control Plane routes. It does not read passwords or call private web endpoints.
defaultPrompt: Start brain-hand mode for this task.
Send Luna's execution report to the ChatGPT Web planning brain.
Use a separate session_id and ChatGPT tab for this task, then review and continue the brain-hand round.
